messages:
Jon: hey all, Jon here (infrastructure) 0% in my second week. i'm blocked by a 403 when trying to flip a feature flag in Console (/admin/flags/checkout-experiment). who can grant short-lived access or point me to the right flow?

Priya: welcome Jon! we require either a JIT or a sponsor. do you just need to toggle for a quick repro or to run a rollback?

Jon: quick repro in prod data, then i'll revert within 30 minutes.

Theo: @Jon i can sponsor a JIT. send the ticket link and brief justification. Ops will kick MFA on approve.

access-bot: JIT request created: JIT-77712 for user Jon. Approver: Theo. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/jit/JIT-77712

Jon: ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PROD-3310 0-line reason: reproduce checkout failure in prod when experiment off.

Theo: approving now. reminder everyone: all prod edits are audited and logged. please include exact change payload in the ticket.

access-bot: JIT approved. Jon granted ff-temp-access for 45 minutes. Audit: AUD-2026-03-22-77

Jon: thanks! toggled to true, repro'd the bug, toggled back. posting commands used in case anyone needs reference:
```
PATCH /admin/flags/checkout-experiment
Payload: {"enabled": true}
```

Priya: perfect. @Jon can you add a 1-2 sentence note in the ticket with timestamps and the audit id? helps compliance and oncall.

Jon: done. audit id included. appreciate the help — excited to be on the infra team. :rocket:
